name: smoke_web1
prompt: Wide editorial photograph. A ceramicist's bright studio: hands shaping a pale clay bowl on a wheel on the right third of the frame, shelves of unglazed pots softly out of focus behind, diffuse north-window light. The left half of the frame is a clean, softly lit plaster wall with plenty of negative space for a headline. Palette of warm clay, bone white and dusty blue. Shot on a 50 mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, true-to-life colour, subtle film grain. No text, no letters, no logos.
